verdict.rationale: Kimi's help center lists a dedicated Deep Research (深度研究) product section, and search is listed as a general feature. That shows the product ships a deep-research capability, but the evidence is only a help-center category heading with no description of how a run works. missing for 10: documentation that a run autonomously searches many sources, evidence that it returns a cited report, any detail on run depth or source count, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can launch a deep research run that autonomously searches many sources and returns a cited report
